final_message:
The bug in `src/wrap.py` has been fixed. The issue was that when a word was longer than the specified width, the condition `len(cur) + extra > width` would incorrectly trigger for empty `cur`, resulting in an empty string being appended to lines. 

**Fix:** Changed `if len(cur) + extra > width:` to `if cur and len(cur) + extra > width:` so that we only append non-empty lines, allowing words longer than the width to simply go on their own line.

All tests pass with this fix.
